# Xray-core

The MyProxy Xray release channel uses the unmodified Xray-core binary as a
separate process.

- Source: https://github.com/XTLS/Xray-core
- Version used by `scripts/fetch-xray.sh`: `v26.10.21`
- Version source: https://github.com/XTLS/Xray-core/tree/v26.10.21
- Source revision: `1b1647cd9ddf0abc34b981d4611fc03bcac1ca74`
- License: Mozilla Public License 2.0, included in `LICENSE`
- Fetch: `scripts/fetch-xray.sh`

The binary is downloaded during packaging. The Xray release channel is
maintained alongside the existing Prod and Nightly release channels.
